items.sum_en: In the fourth T20 international match against India in Hyderabad, West Indies captain Shai Hope impressed with his amazing batting. Along with his unbeaten 102 off 50 balls, Muthoot received the Fincorp Golden Player of the Match award. West Indies won the match by 24 runs and leveled the five-match series 2-2 at the Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium. Hope hit four fours and nine sixes in his innings. Apart from scoring 102 off 50 balls at a strike rate of 204, he was instrumental in the WestIndies scoring 247 for the loss of three wickets in 20 overs. India were limited to 223 runs in chasing down the target.
items.sum_te: హైదరాబాద్‌లో ఇండియాతో జరిగిన నాలుగో టీ20 అంతర్జాతీయ మ్యాచ్‌లో వెస్టిండీస్‌ కెప్టెన్‌ షాయ్‌ హోప్‌ అద్భుత బ్యాటింగ్‌తో ఆకట్టుకున్నాడు. 50 బంతుల్లో అజేయంగా 102 పరుగులు సాధించడంతో పాటుగా ముత్తూట్‌ ఫిన్‌కార్ప్‌ గోల్డెన్‌ ప్లేయర్‌ ఆఫ్‌ ది మ్యాచ్‌ అవార్డు అందుకున్నాడు. రాజీవ్‌ గాంధీ అంతర్జాతీయ క్రికెట్‌ స్టేడియంలో జరిగిన ఈ మ్యాచ్‌లో వెస్టిండీస్‌ 24 పరుగుల తేడాతో విజయం సాధించి, ఐదు మ్యాచ్‌ల సిరీస్‌ను 2- 2తో సమం చేసింది. హోప్‌ తన ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో నాలుగు ఫోర్లు, తొమ్మిది సిక్సర్లు బాదాడు. 50 బంతులలో 204 స్ట్రైక్‌రేట్‌తో 102 పరుగులు సాధించడంతో పాటుగా వెస్టిండీస్‌ జట్టు 20 ఓవర్లలో మూడు వికెట్ల నష్టానికి 247 పరుగుల భారీ స్కోరు చేయడంలో కీలక పాత్ర పోషించాడు. లక్ష్య ఛేదనలో భారత్‌ 223 పరుగులకే పరిమితమైంది.

He said that from 9th to 14th of this month, 2,474 buses have been run successfully and 94.07 percent of the target has been achieved.

items.sum_en: West Indies won by 24 runs in the fourth T20 match against India at the Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium in Uppal on Wednesday. With this win, West Indies leveled the series at 22. Batting first, West Indies scored 247 runs for the loss of 3 wickets in 20 overs. items.sum_en: As part of the Dussehra Sharannavaratri celebrations, the Durga Mata Mandapam in West Bengal's Siliguri is surprising the devotees. On the occasion of the 64th anniversary of the Central Colony Durga Pua Committee here, the idols were specially decorated with 120 kg gold ornaments. The idols of Goddess Lakshmi, Saraswati, Vinayaka, Karthikeya and other deities including Durgamma were decorated. These were donated by local jewelery shopkeepers. The organizers said that the value of these will be around Rs.170 crores. Armed forces constantly monitor the mandap for security reasons.
items.sum_te: దసరా శరన్నవరాత్రి ఉత్సవాల్లో భాగంగా పశ్చిమ బెంగల్‌లోని సిలిగుడిలో ఏర్పాటు చేసి దుర్గా మాత మండపం భక్తులను ఆశ్చర్యపరుస్తోంది. ఇక్కడి సెంట్రల్ కాలనీ దుర్గా పూా కమిటీ 64వ వార్షికోత్సవం సందర్భంగా దేవతామూర్తులకు 120 కిలోల స్వర్ణాభరణఆలతో ప్రత్యేకంగా అలంకరించారు. దుర్గమ్మతో సహా లక్ష్మీదేవి, సరస్వతి, వినాయకుడు, కార్తికేయ, ఇతర దేవతామూర్తుల విగ్రహాలను అలంకరించారు. వీటిని స్థానిక జ్యువెల్లరీ దుకాణాదారులు విరాళంగా అందించారు. వీటి విలువ సుమారు రూ.170 కోట్లు ఉంటుందని నిర్వాహకులు తెలిపారు. భద్రతా కారణాల దృష్ట్యా సాయుధ బలగాలు మండపాన్ని నిరంతరం పర్యవేక్షిస్తున్నాయి.

items.title: Scientists may have finally solved the mystery of the Moon’s two faces
items.summary: Scientists may have solved a long-standing mystery about why the Moon’s two sides are so different, using samples collected from its farside for the first time. Their findings suggest that uneven heating from Earth's…
items.sum_en: Scientists may have solved a long-standing mystery about why the Moon’s two sides are so different, using samples collected from its farside for the first time. Their findings suggest that uneven heating from Earth's gravitational pull drove enormous flows of ancient magma, creating the dramatically different lunar landscapes we see today.

items.title: AI can act exactly like a human, but we still don't think it's conscious
items.summary: A new study reveals that people draw a surprisingly sharp line between human consciousness and artificial intelligence, even when both behave identically. Researchers found that participants considered even the most…
items.sum_en: A new study reveals that people draw a surprisingly sharp line between human consciousness and artificial intelligence, even when both behave identically. Researchers found that participants considered even the most responsive AI less conscious than the least responsive human. Yet when asked about "awareness" instead, people judged humans and AI much more similarly.

items.title: This tiny jurassic predator helped pave the way for the human brain
items.summary: A 165-million-year-old fossil has revealed an extraordinary Jurassic predator that may help explain how mammals developed one of their most important evolutionary advantages. Although only 20 inches long, Megacauda…
items.sum_en: A 165-million-year-old fossil has revealed an extraordinary Jurassic predator that may help explain how mammals developed one of their most important evolutionary advantages. Although only 20 inches long, Megacauda sungei was a heavyweight among early mammal relatives, swimming through ancient waterways and hunting prey with specialized teeth. Its advanced swallowing anatomy reveals an early step toward the ability to safely nurse on milk, a key development in mammalian evolution.

items.title: Scientists uncover the 2.3-billion-year-old secret that helped keep Earth habitable
items.summary: Scientists may have solved a 2.3-billion-year-old mystery about how Earth maintained enough oxygen to support life. Ancient rocks reveal that phosphorus recycling in the oceans created a self-sustaining cycle that…
items.sum_en: Scientists may have solved a 2.3-billion-year-old mystery about how Earth maintained enough oxygen to support life. items.title: Scientists make stunning discovery that could help explain why life exists
items.summary: Scientists have discovered that the universe's fundamental physical constants may be finely balanced to make life possible. Even tiny changes to these constants could make liquids too thick or too thin for essential…
items.sum_en: Scientists have discovered that the universe's fundamental physical constants may be finely balanced to make life possible. Even tiny changes to these constants could make liquids too thick or too thin for essential biological processes, potentially preventing life as we know it. Surprisingly, these life-friendly conditions existed billions of years before living cells appeared. The findings raise intriguing questions about why the laws of physics seem so well suited to life.

items.title: Eating olive oil before carbs has a surprising effect on blood sugar
items.summary: A simple change in the order you eat your food could help prevent blood sugar spikes. Scientists discovered that giving mice olive oil before carbohydrates slowed digestion and activated a surprising combination of…
items.sum_en: A simple change in the order you eat your food could help prevent blood sugar spikes.
